item.title: Center Grove’s Gertie the goat becomes a meme sensation
item.description: Gertie the Goat became a meme sensation in Center Grove after escaping for several weeks, capturing the hearts of the local community, and was eventually rescued and found a new forever home.

item.title: Colts’ Shane Steichen provides update on Anthony Richardson
item.description: Colts head coach Shane Steichen has decided not to activate Anthony Richardson due to vision limitations from an orbital fracture, and Riley Leonard will be the starting quarterback for the Week 18 finale against the Houston Texans.

item.title: Truck overturns on I-65 in White County, killing passenger
item.description: A passenger in a truck died in an early morning crash on I-65 in rural White County, Indiana State Police say. The other occupants were taken to Lafayette area hospitals with injuries not believed to be life-threatening.

item.title: Unrestrained driver killed, passenger injured in Madison County crash
item.description: Darren Lockhart, 37, of Anderson, died in a single-car crash on a rural road in northern Madison County, while passenger Robert Cantrall, 32, suffered severe head injuries and was taken to Community Hospital Anderson.

item.title: Watch All ACcess Indy: Pasadena to get ready for IU in the Rose Bowl
item.description: IU is set to face Alabama in the Rose Bowl on Thursday, marking its first appearance in the game in 58 years.

item.title: Indianapolis law firm offers free rides to prevent drunk driving on NYE
item.description: Eskew Law is offering to pay for Uber, Lyft, and Taxi rides for the first 50 people who submit receipts, in order to promote safe holiday travel in Indianapolis.

item.title: Some slick travel possible Thursday AM, quiet pattern overall to start 2026 | Dec. 31, 2025
item.description: Light snow accumulation is expected to continue through New Year's Eve in Indiana, with temperatures dropping into the 20s and 30s, before warming up to the mid 30s by the weekend.

item.title: Curt Cignetti’s advice to IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza
item.description: IU football has achieved unprecedented success this season, completing its first perfect regular season and reaching the No. 1 ranking for the first time in program history, led by head coach Curt Cignetti and quarterback Fernando Mendoza, who won the Heisman Trophy.

item.title: Fernando Mendoza’s ‘generous gift’ for IU’s Catholic leaders
item.description: Indiana University quarterback Fernando Mendoza recently celebrated his Heisman Trophy victory by taking the trophy to the St. Paul Catholic Center on IU's campus.

item.title: Indiana’s new vehicle registration law takes effect Jan. 1
item.description: Hoosiers are required to update their vehicle registration if their vehicle's exterior appearance has changed, and failure to do so could result in a warning from law enforcement or a Class C misdemeanor.
